### Shiny Application for a Living Systematic Review on Residential Exposure to Animal Feeding Operations (AFOs)


This repository hosts the source code and datasets for an interactive Shiny web
application designed to support a living systematic review (LSR). The platform
integrates data visualization, interactivity, and accessibility to enhance evidence
communication and facilitate user engagement.

## Features
The application provides the following key features:

Timeline of Relevant Papers

Chronological representation of all identified papers, with clickable references redirecting to PubMed.
Additional interactive timelines filtered by health outcomes in the Health Outcomes tab.
Geographic Maps

Interactive maps displaying the spatial distribution of included studies.
Helps identify under-represented regions and areas requiring further research.
Study Flowchart

Visualizes the PRISMA flow diagram to represent the study selection process.
Interactive Forest Plots

Allows dynamic exploration of results for multiple exposure-disease pairs.
Includes risk-of-bias judgments and rationale for each domain.
Bias Assessment Visualization

Bar charts for overall bias assessments and traffic-light plots for domain-specific evaluations.
Searchable Tables

Interactive tables with bibliographic information, enabling easy access to study details.
Getting Started
Prerequisites
R version 4.0 or higher
Required R packages: shiny, ggplot2, dplyr, leaflet, reshape2, and others listed in the DESCRIPTION file.
